\ubblockdescription{catalogue.snippets}{EXPERIMENTAL: on two M2\_aug 24 h spans and one known drop chain its regimes were no more persistent than on phase-randomised surrogates; on a second chain (72 h) its k = 3 regimes were three times as persistent and beat every surrogate, but its knee chose k = 1 --- so set k by hand and read the run lengths (docs/prompts/blocks/reports/W2-evaluation.md). What kinds of behaviour does this recording hold, and where? Picks the two to six most typical pieces (snippets) and colours every window by the snippet it most resembles --- like the few thumbnail frames that best represent a film, with a bar showing which frame each scene is closest to. Put Sliding windows (gap 0) before it: the windows are the pieces (an hour is a good start) --- and Baseline removal before that. Tune `subseq\_frac` first. k = 0 lets the paper's knee choose how many; k = 1 means no evidence of more than one kind. Shapes are compared after z-normalisation, so a quiet stretch of pure noise has no shape of its own and is absorbed by whichever snippet it happens to resemble --- read the run lengths: a label that flickers window to window is not a regime. Trust the automatic k from 24 pieces (24 h of 1-hour pieces) on. Windows more than half NaN are \ensuremath{-}1. Costs O(n\ensuremath{^2}): about 25 s for 24 h at 1 Hz here; refused above 7 days.}
